plan: OpenVibe.Meme: the open meme database rebuilt with AI — entries built from OpenVibe's own running jokes, each cited to the moment it happened, a timeline of later uses, a status, meme of the week and a caption generator on templates
summary: OpenVibe.Meme is the open meme database, rebuilt with AI. The importer reads only public Chat and Live APIs and proposes a candidate when a recurring phrase appears in at least two uses on two different days; the candidate is born hidden with a verbatim citation for every use and stays hidden until a staff person publishes it. Every citation is re-verified daily, a 404 marks it gone and an entry whose origin is gone is hidden. People vote once a week for meme of the week, and a caption is plain text over a template, never a rendered image. Every public entry is one Search Fabric document queued in the service's outbox.
works: Entries with a unique slug, kind, AI summary passing noLooks, status and status history, first/last seen, visibility and a revision that goes up on every change
Citations with role origin/use/example, verbatim quote and sha256, canonical OpenVibe.Video URL, VOD seconds, observed time and source_status live/hidden/gone
The public importer: Chat history/timeline, Rundown topics and segments, VOD transcripts; a recurring phrase across ≥2 uses on ≥2 days; hidden candidates only, never a publish
Daily citation re-verification: 404/410 → gone, 401/403 → hidden, the origin gone hides the entry, a transient 5xx changes nothing
The fixed deny list: VOD 5709 and clip 483 are never cited, cached or rendered
Meme of the week: ISO weeks, one ballot per week and person, a second vote changes the choice
The caption generator: a template, 1–4 lines × 120 characters, a blocked-word list, server-rendered HTML preview, text lines stored in jsonb
The API: public cursor-paged entries, an entry with citations and timeline, a zero-filled use series, trending, the week, templates, captions, reports, and staff publish/hide/patch
Search Fabric documents (owner meme, type entry, /m/<slug>) in meme_outbox, with a tombstone when an entry is hidden
Sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (PKCE S256, meme_at/meme_rt/meme_oauth), staff role global_mod+
Account export and deletion over votes, captions and reports
Server-rendered pages with stable mm- ids/classes, cache headers, discovery artifacts and deploy files
notYet: The Search document relay: documents wait in meme_outbox until Network grants meme search.document.write
A per-message Chat permalink API; a chat citation stores the message id and the public history is re-read to verify it
Automatic status transitions by the proposed rising/peaked/classic/dead rules; the importer sets a first status and staff can change it
Real template artwork: v1 ships three data-free local SVG placeholders; a real template is an openvibe.media object
A staff moderation screen beyond GET /api/v1/reports; reports are stored and read through the API
A cron/startup backfill of the proof beyond scripts/seed-proof.js
deployment: not deployed: the unit and nginx vhost are deploy/systemd/openvibe-meme.service and deploy/nginx/openvibe.meme.conf
